Unwanted script effects can be removed at any time by disabling all permissions for that effect (including 'Self').
To find out more about the properties that you can assign permissions for and what each might do and the associated risks, click the '?' icon next to each one.

为了减少问题并保持视觉效果统一的基准水平，束缚俱乐部包含一系列措施，可防止人们以可能导致错误或显示问题的方式修改你的物品。在此屏幕上，你可以选择允许某些人通过自定义脚本或插件绕过这些限制。这可以允许对项目进行更高程度的图形定制，但请注意，它也可能导致严重的显示错误，包括导致物品或角色不可见，因此使用这些选项需要你自担风险。要了解有关你可以为其分配权限的属性以及每个属性可能执行的操作以及相关风险的更多信息，请单击每个“？”旁边的图标。 请注意，将权限设置为公开意味着任何人都可以修改该功能，甚至是故意破坏者，因此请谨慎使用。请记住，你可以随时通过删除该效果的所有权限（包括“自身”）来删除不需要的脚本效果。

Permits scripts to override the default item-hiding behaviour of Bondage Club. This can enhance your game by allowing item combinations that wouldn't normally be possible, or by allowing items to be hidden to achieve a particular look that doesn't necessarily reflect exactly what you're wearing. However, it can also be used to create severe visual glitches, including making items or even your whole character invisible. Use with caution!

Permits scripts to override the default item-blocking behaviour of Bondage Club. This is the functionality that prevents you from equipping items on others, or can prevent sexual activities on blocked zones. bcplus.Color scheme of the BC+ window when the: 未运行 Themed 模组时使用的 BC+ 窗口配色。安装 Themed 后会自动采用它的配色。
bcplus.Fetches the BC+ release manifest at logi: 在登录时及下方设置的间隔获取 BC+ 发布清单。请求仅携带你运行的 BC+ 版本，不含会员编号、姓名等信息；作者通过请求次数统计匿名使用量。关闭后 BC+ 不再发送更新请求。
bcplus.Shows [BC+] chat messages once after BC+: BC+ 更新后显示一次 [BC+] 聊天通知；发现新版本时，每次会话也会通知一次（不在房间时显示角落蜂鸣提示）。也可通过 /bcp updates on|off 切换。
bcplus.How often BC+ re-reads the release manif: 登录期间重新读取发布清单的间隔，确保长时间在线也能获知新版本。“仅在登录时”只在登录时检查一次。发现更新后，按上方通知设置每次会话提示一次。
bcplus.Dominant: BC+ rules, curses and logging: 支配者：BC+ 规则、诅咒与日志不作用于你，初始权限关闭。转换者／服从者：全部功能可用，采用适中的默认权限。奴隶：禁止自行修改规则、诅咒、权限、角色与关系。选择后预设即锁定，只有恢复出厂设置才能清除。
bcplus.Draws the BC+ logo next to BC's status i: 在所有运行 BC+ 的角色（包括你）上方的 BC 状态图标旁显示 BC+ 标志。悬停可查看版本；图标变灰代表对方权限未授予你访问权。
bcplus.Draws the stat rings of every BC+ virtua: 显示房间内所有分享状态的 BC+ 虚拟宠物的状态环，悬停可查看准确数值。无需启用宠物模块，查看宠物状态不会让你也成为宠物。
bcplus.While your hands are bound, your own BC+: 双手被束缚时，你无法打开自己的 BC+ 菜单或使用 /bcp 指令来修改配置。其他人仍可远程操作你的 BC+。这是个人设置，无法被远程修改，但“硬核模式”规则生效时会强制开启。
bcplus.Anyone whose hands are bound is refused: 双手被束缚的人无法修改你的任何 BC+ 设置，包括规则、诅咒、惩罚、角色及指令等。这是个人设置，无法被远程修改，但“硬核模式”规则生效时会强制开启。
bcplus.Each entry controls one BC+ permission:: 每项设置控制一个 BC+ 权限，包括可对你使用它的最低角色，以及你是否可以对自己使用。角色顺序为 BC 主人 > 共同主人 > 恋人 > 女主人 > 白名单 > 好友 > 所有人。屏蔽名单与黑名单中的成员始终无法使用。
bcplus.Choose what this role's grant covers: ev: 选择此角色的授权范围：全部，或仅勾选项目。成员只能在授权项目上使用此权限。
bcplus.Manage who holds BC+ roles: BC Owner and: 管理 BC+ 角色的持有人。BC 主人与恋人始终依据实际游戏关系，无法手动分配；共同主人与女主人可在此页面分配；白名单与好友直接采用 BC 列表。
bcplus.When BCX's version of a BC+ rule is in e: 对应的 BCX 规则生效时，BC+ 规则会暂停，避免两个模组重复限制同一行为。BCX 诅咒作用于同一物品栏位时，BC+ 诅咒也会让位。
bcplus.A cursed slot only accepts its allowed i: 被诅咒的栏位只接受获准物品。每件物品可独立设置规则：严格模式恢复记录时的颜色、类型与制作信息，宽松模式只要求是同一物品。空栏位受到诅咒后会保持空置。栏位也可指定挂锁；物品未上锁或使用其他锁时，将重新上指定的锁。
bcplus.Punishments are applied automatically wh: 违反附有惩罚的规则时会自动受罚：强制穿戴物品（移除后会恢复），或在一段时间内强制启用另一条规则。先在此定义惩罚，再于规则配置页中关联。
bcplus.A contract bundles rules with their sett: 契约将规则、设置与条件组合在一起，由你在自己的 BC+ 中起草并提供给他人。只有对方审阅并签署后才会生效。签署后，规则将保持约束力，直到契约到期或按约定解除。
bcplus.Everything configured in your BCX, ready: 此处列出可复制到 BC+ 的 BCX 配置。按下迁移后会应用勾选项目，不会修改 BCX 的任何内容。BCX 规则仍生效时，迁移的对应 BC+ 规则会让位。
bcplus.The behavior log records rule violations: 行为日志记录违规、被阻止的尝试、诅咒触发及他人做出的修改。谁能查看或清空日志由权限页面控制，也包括你能否查看自己的日志。
bcplus.BC+ counts how your play time is spent -: BC+ 会统计你的游玩时长分布，包括受束缚、被口塞堵嘴、项圈焊接及穿戴不同物品的时间，以及违规、惩罚等事件。谁能查看或重置统计由权限页面控制。

bcplus.Gag garbling happens on the speaker's cl: 口塞含糊语音由说话者的客户端生成，因此只有消息同时携带未处理原文时此功能才有效。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to unlock any locked item on other club members, with options to still allow unlocking of owner and/or lover locks and items\. Note: Despite the name, this rule also blocks unlocking locks that don't require a key \(e\.g\. exclusive lock\)\. However, locks that can be unlocked in other ways \(timer locks by removing time, code/password locks by entering correct code\) can still be unlocked by \1\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 解开其他俱乐部成员身上任何锁定的物品，可选择仍允许解开主人和/或恋人的锁与物品。注意：尽管名称如此，此规则也会阻止解开无需钥匙的锁（如专属锁）。但可用其他方式解开的锁（定时锁通过减少时间、密码锁通过输入正确密码）$1 仍可解开。

CN.p: ^(.+?) picking one on \1$
CN.r: $1 撬开 $1 身上的

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to lockpick any locked items on her own body\. \(Others still can pick locks on her normally\)$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 撬开自己身上任何锁定的物品。（他人仍可正常撬开她身上的锁）

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to lockpick any locked items on other club members\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 撬开其他俱乐部成员身上锁定的物品。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use any kind of lock on her own body\. \(Others still can add locks on her items normally\)$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 对自己身体使用任何锁。（他人仍可正常为她的物品加锁）

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use any kind of lock on other club members\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 对其他俱乐部成员使用任何锁。

CN.p: ^(.+?) using \1's wardrobe$
CN.r: $1 使用 $1 的衣橱

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to access her own wardrobe\. \(Others still can change her clothes normally\)$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 访问自己的衣橱。（他人仍可正常更换她的衣物）

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use the wardrobe of other club members\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 使用其他俱乐部成员的衣橱。

CN.p: ^Allows to restrict the body poses (.+?) is able to get into by herself\.$
CN.r: 可限制 $1 自己能够摆出的身体姿势。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to create new rooms\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 创建新房间。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to enter all rooms, that are not on an editable whitelist of still allowed ones\. NOTE: As safety measure this rule is not in effect while the list is empty\. TIP: This rule can be combined with the rule "Forbid creating new rooms"\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 进入所有不在可编辑白名单中的房间。注意：作为安全措施，列表为空时此规则不生效。提示：此规则可与「禁止创建新房间」规则搭配使用。

CN.p: ^This rule prevents (.+?) from leaving the room they are currently inside while at least one character with the set minimum role or a higher one is present inside\. NOTE: Careful when setting the minimum role too low\. If it is set to public for instance, it would mean that \1 can only leave the room when they are alone in it\.$
CN.r: 此规则会在房间内至少有一名达到所设最低角色或更高角色的角色时，阻止 $1 离开当前房间。注意：将最低角色设得过低时要小心。例如设为「公开」，就意味着 $1 只有在房间里独处时才能离开。

CN.p: ^(.+?) removing any items from \1's body$
CN.r: $1 从 $1 身上移除任何物品

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to remove any items from her own body\. Other people can still remove them\. The rule has a toggle to optionally still allow to remove items which were given a low difficulty score by the original asset maker, such as hand-held items, plushies, etc\. This means that custom crafted properties given to an item such as 'decoy' are not factored in\. It also has a toggle to prevent swapping items\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 从自己身上移除任何物品。他人仍可移除。规则有一个开关可选择仍允许移除原作者给予低难度分的物品（如手持物、毛绒玩具等）。这意味着物品的自定义制作属性（如「诱饵」）不计入。规则还有一个开关可阻止交换物品。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to remove any items from other characters\. The rule has a toggle to optionally still allow to remove items which were given a low difficulty score by the original asset maker, such as hand-held items, plushies, etc\. This means that custom crafted properties given to an item such as 'decoy' are not factored in\. It also has a toggle to prevent swapping items\.$
CN.r: 这条规则禁止 $1 移除其他角色的任何物品。该规则设有一个开关，可选择性允许移除原资产制作者评定为低难度分数的物品，例如手持物品、毛绒玩具等。这意味着给予物品的自定义属性（如“诱饵”）不会被纳入考量。该规则还有一个开关，用于阻止物品交换。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use any items on herself\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 对自己使用任何物品。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use any items on other characters\. Can be set to only affect using items on characters with a higher dominant / lower submissive score than \1 has\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 对其他角色使用任何物品。可设为仅影响对支配分高于/顺从分低于 $1 的角色使用物品。

CN.p: ^This rule prevents (.+?) from adding characters with the set minimum role or a higher one to their bondage club blacklist and ghostlist\.$
CN.r: 此规则阻止 $1 将达到所设最低角色或更高角色的角色加入其束缚俱乐部黑名单和鬼隐名单。

CN.p: ^This rule prevents (.+?) from adding characters with a role lower than a BCX Mistress to their bondage club whitelist\.$
CN.r: 此规则阻止 $1 将角色低于 BCX 女主人的角色加入其束缚俱乐部白名单。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use the antiblind command\. Antiblind is a BCX feature that enables a BCX user to see the whole chat room and all other characters at all times, even when wearing a blinding item\. If \1 should be forbidden to use the command, this rule should be used\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 使用 antiblind 命令。Antiblind 是一项 BCX 功能，让 BCX 用户即使佩戴致盲物品也能始终看到整个聊天室和所有其他角色。若要禁止 $1 使用该命令，应使用此规则。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to change her Bondage Club multiplayer difficulty, regardless of the current value\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 更改其束缚俱乐部多人难度，无论当前值为何。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use any \(sexual\) activities in chat rooms\. Other players can still use activities on her, as this rules does not block the arousal & sexual activities system itself, as forcing the according BC setting would\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 在聊天室使用任何（性）动作。其他玩家仍可对她使用动作，因为此规则本身不会像强制相应 BC 设置那样禁用兴奋与性动作系统。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use a maid's help to get out of restraints in the club's main hall\. Recommended to combine with the rule: 'Force 'Cannot enter single-player rooms when restrained' \(Existing BC setting\)' to prevent NPCs in other rooms from helping\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 在俱乐部大厅利用女仆的帮助解除束缚。建议与规则「强制『被束缚时无法进入单人房间』（现有 BC 设置）」搭配，以防其他房间的 NPC 提供帮助。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use the action command\. Action is a BCX feature that enables to format a message to look like a BC chat action\. If \1 should be forbidden to use the command to communicate, this rule should be used\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 使用 action 命令。Action 是一项 BCX 功能，可将消息格式化为看起来像 BC 聊天动作。若要禁止 $1 用该命令交流，应使用此规则。

CN.p: ^(.+?) using her permissions for her own BCX, with some exceptions$
CN.r: $1 对自己的 BCX 使用其权限，但有若干例外

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) access to some parts of their own BCX they have permission to use, making it as if they do not have 'self access' \(see BCX tutorial on permission system\) while the rule is active\. This rule still leaves access for all permissions where the lowest permitted role \('lowest access'\) is also set to \1 \(to prevent getting stuck\)\. This rule does not affect \1's permissions to use another users's BCX\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 访问自己 BCX 中某些她本有权使用的部分，规则生效期间就如同她没有「自我访问」权限（见 BCX 权限系统教学）。对于最低许可角色（「最低访问」）也设为 $1 的所有权限，此规则仍保留访问（以防被卡死）。此规则不影响 $1 使用他人 BCX 的权限。

CN.p: ^(.+?) accessing curses placed on herself by others$
CN.r: $1 访问他人对她施加的诅咒

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) from accessing \(or removing\) any curses that were placed on her by other BCX users\. This additionally blocks bulk actions and editing the global config to prevent bypassing this rule\. \1 can still access \(and remove\) curses she herself placed\. This rule does not affect \1's permissions to use another users' BCX\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 访问（或移除）其他 BCX 用户对她施加的任何诅咒。这还会阻止批量操作和编辑全局配置，以防绕过此规则。$1 仍可访问（并移除）她自己施加的诅咒。此规则不影响 $1 使用他人 BCX 的权限。

CN.p: ^(.+?) accessing rules placed on herself by others$
CN.r: $1 访问他人对她施加的规则

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) from accessing \(or removing\) any rules that were placed on her by other BCX users\. This additionally blocks bulk actions and editing the global config to prevent bypassing this rule\. \1 can still access \(and remove\) rules she herself placed\. This rule does not affect \1's permissions to use another users' BCX\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 访问（或移除）其他 BCX 用户对她施加的任何规则。这还会阻止批量操作和编辑全局配置，以防绕过此规则。$1 仍可访问（并移除）她自己施加的规则。此规则不影响 $1 使用他人 BCX 的权限。

CN.p: ^\((.+?) accessing curses placed on herself by others\)$
CN.r: （即 $1 获取他人对自己施加的诅咒）

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) from accessing \(or removing\) any curses that were placed on her by other BCX users\. This additionally blocks bulk actions and editing the global config to prevent bypassing this rule\. \1 can still access \(and remove\) curses she herself placed\. This rule does not affect \1 permissions to use another users' BCX\.$
CN.r: 这条规则禁止 $1 访问（或移除）任何由其他 BCX 用户对她施加的诅咒。此规则同时阻止批量操作和编辑全局配置，以防止绕过该规则。$1 仍然可以访问（及移除）她自己施加的诅咒。此规则不影响 $1 使用其他用户 BCX 的权限。

CN.p: ^\((.+?) accessing rules placed on herself by others\)$
CN.r: （即 $1 获取他人对自己设定的规则）

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) from accessing \(or removing\) any rules that were placed on her by other BCX users\. This additionally blocks bulk actions and editing the global config to prevent bypassing this rule\. \1 can still access \(and remove\) rules she herself placed\. This rule does not affect \1 permissions to use another users' BCX\.$
CN.r: 这条规则禁止 $1 访问（或移除）任何由其他 BCX 用户对她设定的规则。此规则同时阻止批量操作和编辑全局配置，以防止绕过该规则。$1 仍然可以访问（及移除）她自己设定的规则。此规则不影响 $1 使用其他用户 BCX 的权限。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) from opening the room admin screen while blindfolded, as this discloses the room background and the member numbers of admins, potentially in the room right now\. If \1 is a room admin, she can still use chat commands for altering the room or kicking/banning\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 在被蒙眼时打开房间管理界面，因为这会泄露房间背景和管理员（可能正在房间内）的会员编号。若 $1 是房间管理员，她仍可使用聊天命令更改房间或踢出/封禁。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to revieve training by the base club's GGTS feature\. If the rule is enforced while \1 has remaining GGTS training time, it is removed the moment \1 enters the GGTS room\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 接受基础俱乐部 GGTS 功能的训练。若在 $1 还有剩余 GGTS 训练时间时强制此规则，则在她进入 GGTS 房间时立即清除。

CN.p: ^This rule prevents (.+?) to work as a club slave by picking up a club slave collar from the club management room\.$
CN.r: 此规则阻止 $1 通过在俱乐部管理室拿取俱乐部奴隶项圈来充当俱乐部奴隶。

CN.p: ^This rule prevents (.+?) to use items she does not own herself, but can use on someone because this person owns them\.$
CN.r: 此规则阻止 $1 使用她自己不拥有、但因对方拥有而能对其使用的物品。

CN.p: ^for just (.+?)$
CN.r: 仅针对 $1

CN.p: ^This rule prevents (.+?) from showing, removing or changing an emoticon \(afk, zZZ, etc\.\) over her head\. It also blocks her from using the emoticon command on herself\.$
CN.r: 此规则阻止 $1 显示、移除或更改她头顶的表情气泡（afk、zZZ 等）。也会阻止她对自己使用表情气泡命令。

CN.p: ^This rule enforces hiding of certain UI elements for (.+?) over all characters inside the room\. Different levels of the effect can be set which follow exactly the behavior of the 'eye'-toggle in the button row above the chat\. There is also an option to hide emoticon bubbles over all characters' heads\.$
CN.r: 此规则为 $1 强制隐藏房间内所有角色的某些界面元素。可设置不同程度的效果，完全遵循聊天上方按钮行中「眼睛」开关的行为。还有一个选项可隐藏所有角色头顶的表情气泡。

CN.p: ^This rule allows (.+?) to only communicate using a list of specific sound patterns in chat messages and whispers\. These patterns cannot be mixed in the same message, though\. Only one sound from the list per message is valid\. That said, any variation of a sound in the list is allowed as long as the letters are in order\. \(Example: if the set sound is 'Meow', then this is a valid message: 'Me\.\.ow\? meeeow! mmeooowwwwwww\?! meow\. me\.\. oo\.\.w ~'\)$
CN.r: 此规则只允许 $1 在聊天消息和私聊中使用一组特定声音模式交流。但同一条消息中不能混用这些模式，每条消息只能用列表中的一种声音。不过，只要字母顺序不变，列表中某声音的任何变体都被允许。（例如：若设定声音为「Meow」，则这是有效消息：「Me..ow? meeeow! mmeooowwwwwww?! meow. me.. oo..w ~」）

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use OOC \(messages between round brackets\) in chat or OOC whisper messages while she is gagged\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 在被塞口时于聊天或私聊中使用 OOC（圆括号内的消息）。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use OOC \(messages between round brackets\) in chat or OOC whisper messages at any moment\. This is a very extreme rule and should be used with great caution!$
CN.r: 此规则在任何时刻都禁止 $1 在聊天或私聊中使用 OOC（圆括号内的消息）。这是非常极端的规则，请极为谨慎使用！

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use any words longer than set limit and limits number of words too\. Both limits are configurable independently\. Doesn't affect OOC text, but does affect whispers\. Note: Setting '0' means this part is not limited \(∞\), as there is another rule to forbid open talking completely\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 使用超过所设长度上限的词，并同时限制词数。两个上限可独立配置。不影响 OOC 文本，但影响私聊。注意：设为「0」表示该部分不限制（∞），因为另有规则可完全禁止公开说话。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use certain words in the chat\. The list of banned words can be configured\. Checks are not case sensitive \(forbidding 'no' also forbids 'NO' and 'No'\)\. Doesn't affect emotes and OOC text, but does affect whispers\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 在聊天中使用某些词。禁词列表可配置。检查不区分大小写（禁止「no」也会禁止「NO」和「No」）。不影响表情动作和 OOC 文本，但影响私聊。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use certain words as part of any emote messages\. The list of banned words can be configured\. Checks are not case sensitive \(forbidding 'no' also forbids 'NO' and 'No'\)\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 在任何表情动作消息中使用某些词。禁词列表可配置。检查不区分大小写（禁止「no」也会禁止「NO」和「No」）。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to send a message to all people inside a chat room\. Does not affect whispers or emotes, but does affect OOC\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 向聊天室内所有人发送消息。不影响私聊或表情动作，但影响 OOC。

CN.p: ^This rule limits (.+?)'s ability to send a message to all people inside a chat room to only the set number per minute\. Does not affect whispers or emotes, but does affect OOC\. Note: Setting '0' will have no effect, as there is another rule to forbid open talking completely\.$
CN.r: 此规则将 $1 向聊天室内所有人发送消息的能力限制为每分钟仅所设数量。不影响私聊或表情动作，但影响 OOC。注意：设为「0」不会有效果，因为另有规则可完全禁止公开说话。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to send an emote \(with \* or /me\) to all people inside a chat room\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 向聊天室内所有人发送表情动作（用 * 或 /me）。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to send an emote \(with \* or /me\) to all people inside a chat room to only the set number per minute\. Note: Setting '0' will have no effect, as there is another rule to forbid using emotes completely\.$
CN.r: 此规则将 $1 向聊天室内所有人发送表情动作（用 * 或 /me）限制为每分钟仅所设数量。注意：设为「0」不会有效果，因为另有规则可完全禁止使用表情动作。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to whisper anything to most people inside a chat room, except to the defined roles\. Also affects whispered OOC messages\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 向聊天室内大多数人私聊，指定角色除外。也影响私聊的 OOC 消息。

CN.p: ^This rule prevents (.+?) from receiving any whispers, except from the defined roles\. If someone tries to send \1 a whisper message while this rule blocks them from doing so, they get an auto reply whisper, if the rule has an auto reply set \(text field is not empty\)\. \1 won't get any indication that she would have received a whisper unless the rule is not enforced, in which case she will see both the whisper and the auto reply\. This rule can also be used \(by dommes\) to prevent getting unwanted whispers from strangers in public\.$
CN.r: 此规则阻止 $1 接收任何私聊，指定角色除外。若有人在此规则阻止的情况下尝试向 $1 发送私聊，且规则设有自动回复（文本框非空），对方会收到一条自动回复私聊。除非规则未被强制，否则 $1 不会有任何收到私聊的提示；未强制时她会同时看到私聊和自动回复。此规则也可（由支配者）用来防止在公共场合收到陌生人的骚扰私聊。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to send any beeps with message, except to the defined list of member numbers\. Sending beeps without a message is not affected\. Optionally, it can be set that \1 is only forbidden to send beeps while she is unable to use her hands \(e\.g\. fixed to a cross\)\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 发送任何带消息的蜂鸣，指定会员编号列表除外。发送不带消息的蜂鸣不受影响。可选择设为仅在 $1 无法使用双手时（如被固定在十字架上）禁止其发送蜂鸣。

CN.p: ^This rule prevents (.+?) from receiving any beep \(regardless if the beep carries a message or not\), except for beeps from the defined list of member numbers\. If someone tries to send \1 a beep message while this rule blocks them from doing so, they get an auto reply beep, if the rule has an auto reply set\. \1 won't get any indication that she would have received a beep unless the rule is not enforced, in which case she will see both the beep and the auto reply\. Optionally, the rule can be set to only activate while \1 is unable to use her hands \(e\.g\. fixed to a cross\)\.$
CN.r: 此规则阻止 $1 接收任何蜂鸣（无论是否带消息），指定会员编号列表除外。若有人在此规则阻止的情况下尝试向 $1 发送蜂鸣消息，且规则设有自动回复，对方会收到一条自动回复蜂鸣。除非规则未被强制，否则 $1 不会有任何收到蜂鸣的提示；未强制时她会同时看到蜂鸣和自动回复。可选择设为仅在 $1 无法使用双手时（如被固定在十字架上）激活。

CN.p: ^(.+?) will automatically send all defined member numbers \(if they are currently online and friends with \1\) a beep the moment \1 joins the club or the moment she start BCX to make her presence known\. Disconnects don't count as coming into the club again, as far as detectable\. NOTE: Trigger conditions should not be selected when using this rule, as if you for instance select 'when in public room' the rule will only greet when you load BCX in a public room\.$
CN.r: 在 $1 加入俱乐部或启动 BCX 的那一刻，她会自动向所有指定会员编号（若对方当前在线且与 $1 是好友）发送蜂鸣以宣告到场。就可检测范围而言，断线不算再次进入俱乐部。注意：使用此规则时不应选择触发条件，因为例如选择「在公共房间时」，规则只会在你于公共房间加载 BCX 时问候。

CN.p: ^This rule forbids (.+?) to use the antigarble command\. Antigarble is a BCX feature that enables a BCX user to understand muffled voices from other gagged characters or when wearing a deafening item\. If \1 should be forbidden to use the command, this rule should be used\.$
CN.r: 此规则禁止 $1 使用 antigarble 命令。Antigarble 是一项 BCX 功能，让 BCX 用户能听懂其他被塞口角色或自己佩戴致聋物品时的含糊话语。若要禁止 $1 使用该命令，应使用此规则。

CN.p: ^Automatically replaces specific words (.+?) uses in chat messages, whispers and OOC with another set word from a defineable a list of words with a special syntax \(e\.g\. \[Clare,Lily;Mistress\],\[Claudia;the maid\],\[I;this slut\]\)\.$
CN.r: 这条规则自动将 $1 在聊天消息、密语和 OOC 中使用的特定词语，替换为来自可自定义单词列表中的另一个指定词，该列表使用特殊语法（例如 [Clare,Lily;Mistress],[Claudia;the maid],[I;this slut]）。

CN.p: ^This rule forces (.+?) to retype any chat/whisper/emote/OOC message as a punishment when they try to send it and another enforced BCX speech rule determines that there is any rule violation in that message\.$
CN.r: 当 $1 尝试发送聊天/私聊/表情/OOC 消息、而另一条已强制的 BCX 言语规则判定该消息存在违规时，此规则作为惩罚强制她重新输入该消息。

CN.p: ^Sets a specific sentence that (.+?) must say loud after entering a room that is not empty\. The sentence is autopopulating the chat window text input\. When to say it is left to \1, but when the rule is enforced, it is the only thing that can be said in this room after joining it\. Emotes can still be used, though, unless toggled to be forbidden\. Disconnects don't count as coming into a new room again, as far as detectable\.$
CN.r: 设定一句 $1 进入非空房间后必须公开说出的话。该句子会自动填入聊天窗口输入框。何时说由 $1 决定，但规则强制时，进入房间后这是唯一能说的话。不过表情动作仍可使用，除非被切换为禁止。就可检测范围而言，断线不算再次进入新房间。

CN.p: ^Forces (.+?) to greet people newly entering the current chat room with the set sentence\. NOTE: Only \1 and the new guest can see the message not to make it spammy\. After a new person has been greeted, she will not be greeted for 10 minutes after she left \(including disconnect\) the room \1 is in\. Setting an emote as a greeting is also supported by starting the set message with one or two '\*' characters\. %name% is replaced by the name from the relationships module or their normal name\. The %titled_name% prepends Master/Mistress/Owner\.$
CN.r: 强制 $1 用设定句子问候新进入当前聊天室的人。注意：为避免刷屏，只有 $1 和新访客能看到该消息。某人被问候后，在其离开（含断线）$1 所在房间后的 10 分钟内不会再被问候。以一或两个「*」字符开头设定消息，也支持将表情动作作为问候。%name% 会替换为关系模块中的名称或其正常名称。%titled_name% 会在前面加上 主人/女主人/所有者。

CN.p: ^Forces (.+?) to say farewells to people leaving the room slowly\. Only does it once per 10 minutes per room\. Can start with \* or \*\* for emote\.$
CN.r: 强制 $1 向缓慢离开房间的人道别。每个房间每10分钟仅执行一次。可以以 * 或 ** 开头来表示动作（表情）。

CN.p: ^This rule no longer allows (.+?) to speak freely, she is given a set of sentences allowed and can only use those in chat and whispers\. Does not affect OOC\.$
CN.r: 此规则不再允许 $1 自由说话，她会得到一组允许的句子，且只能在聊天和私聊中使用这些句子。不影响 OOC。

CN.p: ^an enhanced studder effect is added to (.+?)'s chat texts$
CN.r: 为 $1 的聊天文本加上增强的结巴效果

CN.p: ^Thus rule converts (.+?)'s messages, so she is only able to speak studdering and with random filler sounds, for some \[RP\] reason \(anxiousness, arousal, fear, etc\.\)\. Converts the typed chat text automatically\. Affects chat messages and whispers, but not OOC\.$
CN.r: 此规则会转换 $1 的消息，使她因某些 [RP] 原因（紧张、兴奋、恐惧等）只能结结巴巴、夹带随机语气词地说话。自动转换所键入的聊天文本。影响聊天消息和私聊，但不影响 OOC。

CN.p: ^This rule gives (.+?) a list of words from which at least one has to always be used in any chat message\. The list of mandatory words can be configured\. Checks are not case sensitive \(adding 'miss' also works for 'MISS' and 'Miss' - Note: 'Miiiiissss' would also match\)\. Doesn't affect whispers, emotes and OOC text\. There is a toggle for affecting whispers, too\.$
CN.r: 此规则给 $1 一份词表，任何聊天消息中都必须至少使用其中一个。必用词列表可配置。检查不区分大小写（加入「miss」对「MISS」和「Miss」也有效——注意：「Miiiiissss」也会匹配）。不影响私聊、表情动作和 OOC 文本。另有一个开关也可影响私聊。

CN.p: ^This rule gives (.+?) a list of words from which at least one has to always be used in any emote message\. The list of mandatory words can be configured\. Checks are not case sensitive \(adding 'miss' also works for 'MISS' and 'Miss' - Note: 'Miiiiissss' would also match\)\.$
CN.r: 此规则给 $1 一份词表，任何表情动作消息中都必须至少使用其中一个。必用词列表可配置。检查不区分大小写（加入「miss」对「MISS」和「Miss」也有效——注意：「Miiiiissss」也会匹配）。

CN.p: ^This rule gives (.+?) ability to understand parts of a muffled sentence ungarbled, based on a white list of words and/or randomly\. On default, applies only to muffled hearing from deafening effects on \1, but optionally can be enhanced to allow also partially understanding the muffled speech of other persons who are speech impaired\. Doesn't affect emotes and OOC text\.$
CN.r: 此规则让 $1 能够基于词语白名单和/或随机地，听清含糊句子的部分内容。默认仅适用于 $1 因致聋效果而产生的含糊听觉，但可选择增强为也能部分听懂其他言语受损者的含糊话语。不影响表情动作和 OOC 文本。

text.If you are permitted, this screen enable: 如果您获得许可, 此屏幕使您能够查看、添加或删除仅限 BCX 的角色“主人”和“女主人”, 这拓展了 BC 的经典角色, 如束缚俱乐部的主人和恋人.可用于在 BCX 中设置各种事项的所有角色的层级结构显示在右侧.角色位置越高, 其权限越大.例如, 如果某事适用于女主人或对其许可, 那么对主人也始终适用.可以设置任意数量的主人和女主人.使用右侧的按钮检查它们对 BCX 的当前权限.
text.we are happy you are interested in our e: 我们很高兴您对我们为束缚俱乐部(BC)所做的扩展感兴趣, 我们在其中投入了大量的空闲时间和热爱.如果您有任何问题、建议或遇到任何错误, 请随时通过 Discord 与我们联系.主菜单中有一个指向它的按钮.
text.The heart of BCX: Allows to configure th: BCX 的核心：允许配置设置和使用 BCX 大部分内容的权限.默认设置取决于所选择的初始 BCX 设置预设.自访问是每个权限旁边的复选框, 最低访问角色在其右侧.例如：如果“允许禁止自访问”“允许授予自访问”“允许最低访问修改”的复选框被取消, 且最低角色是“主人”, 那么当前和新添加的 BCX 所有者以及 BC 所有者可以完全控制他们有权访问的任何权限.所以要小心这三个权限!
text.This screen shows logs of important even: 此界面展示重要事件的日志.所记录的内容取决于日志配置, 可通过右侧的按钮进行查看/编辑.日志条目可以有普通或受保护的可见性.对这些条目的访问以及条目的删除或配置由相应的权限模块权限设置决定.该日志可以记录 BCX 用户的行为、任何违规行为、对 BCX 设置的重要更改、诅咒或规则, 以及他人的注释.
text.This screen determines what is logged in: 此界面决定了行为日志中记录的内容以及每种类型日志消息的可见性.“是”意味着此日志类型具有正常可见性, 而“受保护”意味着只有有权查看受保护条目的角色才能查看它们.“否”表示根本不记录此日志类型.在权限模块的权限设置视图中, 可以配置此日志模块的权限.
text.This screen shows all active curses on t: 此界面展示了玩家身上所有生效的诅咒, 包含诸多信息, 比如持续时间、是被诅咒的物品/服装/身体槽位, 还是强制保持不受限制或赤裸的被封锁物品或服装槽位.点击每行中间带有齿轮图标的按钮, 会将您转到一个新的界面, 允许您配置该诅咒(如果您有权限).当齿轮图标带有蓝色光环时, 意味着该诅咒的条件与全局配置相同.如果允许, 您可以使用“X”按钮删除单个诅咒..
text.The settings on this page are the global: 此页面上的设置是所有新添加诅咒的全局/默认设置.对触发条件的更改也适用于(仍然)设置为全局诅咒配置的现有诅咒, 不过, 如果在此处设置了计时器则是个例外.这样的计时器仅适用于新创建的诅咒.
text.Here, you can add a curse to any empty s: 在此, 您可以向任何空槽(白色)添加诅咒, 使其保持为空, 或者向任何已佩戴的物品(金色)添加诅咒, 使其无法被移除.您只需点击槽位即可添加诅咒, 随后该槽位会变为紫色, 表示已被诅咒.灰色槽位表示由于它们被封锁或您的权限设置, 您无法访问它们.可以通过最右侧的设置按钮来限制/封锁槽位.此屏幕针对角色的身体槽位还有第二页.
text.This screen shows all active rules for t: 此屏幕展示了玩家的所有生效规则, 包含诸多信息, 例如持续时间、规则类型以及显示规则是否正在执行和/或是否记录了违规行为的小状态图标.点击每行中间带有齿轮图标的按钮, 会将您转到一个新的屏幕, 允许您配置该规则(如果您有权限).当齿轮图标带有蓝色光环时, 意味着该规则的条件与全局配置相同.如果允许, 您可以使用“X”按钮删除单个规则.
text.On this screen you can see the available: 在这个屏幕上, 您可以看到玩家可用的命令.点击其中一个命令会显示其更详细的描述.呈灰色的命令表示由于被阻止或权限设置, 您无法访问它们.可以通过最右侧的设置按钮来限制/封锁命令.在聊天室的聊天中, 通过在向其他玩家发送的命令前加上“!”来使用这些命令进行私语交流.注意：某些命令也可以在自己身上使用, 用“.”而不是“!”作为前缀(例如“.eyes close”)
text.Here you can cycle commands between bein: 在这里, 您可以在“不受限制”“受限制”和“被阻止”之间切换命令.“被阻止”意味着无人能够使用此命令, 而“受限制”意味着只有拥有使用受限命令权限的角色才能在该聊天中触发它们.无需保存更改, 因为它们会立即生效.
text.This screen lets you add custom nickname: 此界面可让您为其他俱乐部成员添加自定义昵称.所设置的自定义名称会在该玩家的聊天中取代所添加角色的真实姓名/BC 昵称, 但在被视为脱离角色(OOC)的聊天命令中除外.您还可以强制使用自定义名称, 以阻止玩家发送使用该角色姓名/BC 昵称的聊天消息/私语.对于单个角色, 玩家不能设置多个自定义名称.在该屏幕上设置了自定义名称的角色始终可以在此列表中看到自己所设置的自定义名称.
text.Please select the module feature you wan: 请选择您想要备份或从先前的导出中导入的模块功能.在存储导出的文本之后, 您日后可以再次使用它们, 例如在受诅咒的服装之间切换或不同的规则集之间切换.这些导出在不同的 BCX 用户之间是兼容的, 并且可以由拥有更改相应模块权限的每个 BCX 用户使用.例如, 如果所有者有权控制子项的有限和非有限规则, 那么她也被允许导入先前未被阻止的导出规则.
text.This screen offers various settings to c: 此界面提供了多种通用设置来配置您在 Bondage Club 的体验, 例如启用/禁用打字指示器, 当您正在公共聊天中输入内容或仅向他们私语时, 该指示器会向其他 BCX 用户显示一个图标.作弊仅在设置期间暂时有效；仅通过作弊获得的物品随后也会再次消失.
text.On this screen you can establish new rul: 在这个界面上, 您只需点击任何规则模板即可为玩家制定新规则.点击后, 您可以编辑规则的配置.紫色的规则模板表示它们已在使用中；灰色的规则模板表示由于被阻止或您的权限设置, 您无法访问它们.通过最右侧的设置按钮可以限制/阻止规则模板.注意：如果您希望能够记录规则违规情况, 可能需要在行为日志模块的配置页面中允许这种类型的日志条目.
text.Here you can switch the curse on/off, se: 在这里, 您可以打开/关闭诅咒, 为激活/停用/删除诅咒设置计时器, 并定义其触发条件, 例如始终触发或基于玩家所在位置以及与谁在一起.复选框旁边的小绿/红条表示当前条件是否为真, 而大条表示如果处于激活状态, 该诅咒是否生效.在右侧, 您可以对诸如在背后固定袖口等物品的使用/更改进行诅咒.最后, 在右下角, 您可以将此诅咒的触发条件设置为全局诅咒配置.

text.Templates for storing / overwriting curr: 用于存储/覆盖当前房间信息和设置的模板(按名称切换自动应用)

regex.p: This rule sets (.+)\'s nickname \(replacing her name in most cases\) to any text entered in the rule config\, blocking changes to it from BC's nickname menu\. You can optionally choose whether the previous BC nickname will be restored while the rule is not in effect\.
regex.r: 此规则将 $1 的昵称(在大多数情况下替换她的名字)设置为规则配置中输入的任何文本, 阻止 BC 的昵称菜单更改它. 您还可以选择在规则不生效时是否恢复先前的 BC 昵称.

regex.p: This rule forces (.+) to constantly participate in the kidnappers league\'s suitcase delivery task\, by automatically giving her a new suitcase\, whenever the suitcase item slot is empty\.
regex.r: 此规则强制 $1 不断参与绑匪联盟的手提箱交付任务, 每当手提箱物品槽为空时, 就会自动给她一个新的手提箱.

regex.p: This rule only allows selected roles to leash (.+)\, responding with a message about unsuccessful leashing to others when they attempt to do so\.
regex.r: 此规则只允许选定的角色拴住 $1, 在其他人尝试时向他们回复关于无法拴住的消息.

regex.p: This rule hides persons on (.+)\'s friend list when she is fully blinded\, which also makes sending beeps impossible\. Received beeps can still be answered\. The rule allows to manage a list of members who can be seen normally\.
regex.r: 此规则在 $1 完全失明时隐藏她的好友列表上的人物, 这也使得发送哔声成为不可能. 仍然可以回答接收到的哔声. 规则允许管理一个可以正常看到的成员列表.

regex.p: This rule lets you define a minimum role which \(and all higher roles\) has permission to fully change the whole appearance of (.+) \(body and cosplay items\)\, ignoring the settings of the BC online preferences \'Allow others to alter your whole appearance\' and \'Prevent others from changing cosplay items\'\. So this rule can define a group of people which is allowed\, while everyone else is not\. IMPORTANT\: Only other BCX users will be able to change (.+)\'s appearance if this rule allows them to\, while the BC settings would forbid them to\.
regex.r: 此规则允许您定义一个最低角色, 该角色(及所有更高的角色)具有完全更改 $1 整体外观的权限(包括身体和cosplay物品), 而不考虑 BC 在线首选项 '允许他人更改你的整体外观' 和 '阻止他人更改cosplay物品' 的设置. 因此, 此规则可以定义一个被允许的人群, 而其他所有人则不允许. 重要提示: 只有其他 BCX 用户可以在此规则允许的情况下更改 $2 的外观, 而 BC 设置会禁止他们这样做.

regex.p: This rule forces (.+)\'s base game or BCX setting \'Locks on you can\'t be picked\' to the configured value and prevents her from changing it\. There is also an option to restore the setting to the state it was in before the rule changed it\. The restoration happens either when the rule becomes inactive \(for instance through toggle or unfulfilled trigger conditions\) or when it is removed\.
regex.r: 此规则强制 $1 的基础游戏或 BCX 设置 '锁定在你身上不能被撬开' 为配置的值, 并防止她更改它. 还有一个选项, 可以将设置恢复到规则更改之前的状态. 恢复发生在规则变为非活动状态时(例如通过切换或不符合触发条件)或被移除时.

regex.p: This rule observes (.+)\, logging it as a rule violation if the club was previously entered at least once without BCX active\.
regex.r: 此规则监视 $1, 如果至少有一次在未激活 BCX 的情况下进入俱乐部, 则将其记录为违规.

regex.p: This rule reminds or tells (.+) one of the recorded sentences at random in a settable interval\. Only (.+) can see the set message and it is only shown if in a chat room\.
regex.r: 此规则以可设置的间隔随机提醒或告诉 $1 记录的一条句子. 只有 $2 能看到设置的消息, 并且只在聊天室中显示.

regex.p: This rule gives (.+) ability to understand parts of a muffled sentence ungarbled\, based on a white list of words and\/or randomly\. On default\, applies only to muffled hearing from deafening effects on (.+)\, but optionally can be enhanced to allow also partially understanding the muffled speech of other persons who are speech impaired\. Doesn\'t affect emotes and OOC text\.
regex.r: 此规则赋予 $1 以能够理解部分被压制的句子的能力, 基于一个白名单词汇和/或随机选择. 默认情况下, 仅适用于 $2 受到压制效果而听力受损的情况, 但可选择增强以允许部分理解其他言语受损的人的压抑语音. 不影响表情和 OOC 文本.

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to use the antigarble command\. Antigarble is a BCX feature that enables a BCX user to understand muffled voices from other gagged characters or when wearing a deafening item\. If (.+) should be forbidden to use the command\, this rule should be used\.
regex.r: 此规则禁 $1 使用 antigarble 命令. Antigarble 是 BCX 的一项功能, 允许 BCX 用户在其他被塞口球的角色或佩戴耳聋物品时理解压制的声音. 如果不允许 $2 使用该命令, 应使用此规则.

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to send an emote \(with \* or \/me\) to all people inside a chat room\.
regex.r: 此规则禁 $1 向聊天室内的所有人发送表情符号(使用 * 或 /me).

regex.p: This rule forces (.+)'s base game setting 'Arousal meter' to configurable value and prevents her from changing it.\.
regex.r: 此规则强制控制 $1 的基础游戏设置中的性奋量表模式，并阻止她更改模式.

regex.p: This rule forces (.+)'s base game or BCX setting \'Hide non-adjacent players while partially blind\' to the configured value and prevents her from changing it\. There is also an option to restore the setting to the state it was in before the rule changed it\. The restoration happens either when the rule becomes inactive \(for instance through toggle or unfulfilled trigger conditions\) or when it is removed\.
regex.r: 该规则会强制 $1 的基础游戏或 BCX 设置中的 “部分失明时隐藏非相邻玩家 ”改为你设定的值，并阻止她更改该设置.还有一个选项可以将设置恢复到规则改变之前的状态.当规则失效（例如关闭或触发条件未满足）或被移除时，就会发生恢复.

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to leave their current club owner or get a new one\. Advancing ownership from trial to full ownership is unaffected. Doesn\'t prevent the club owner from releasing her\.
regex.r: 此规则禁 $1 离开她当前的俱乐部所有者或寻找新的. 从试用到完整所有权的提升不受影响. 不阻止俱乐部所有者解救她.

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to get a new lover. Advancing lovership from dating to engagement or from engagement to marriage is unaffected\.
regex.r: 此规则禁 $1 找到新的恋人. 从约会到订婚或从订婚到结婚的提升不受影响.

regex.p: This rule allows (.+) to only communicate using a list of specific sound patterns in chat messages and whispers. These patterns cannot be mixed in the same message, though\. Only one sound from the list per message is valid\. That said, any variation of a sound in the list is allowed as long as the letters are in order\. \(Example\: if the set sound is \'Meow\'\, then this is a valid message\: \'Me\.\.ow\? meeeow\! mmeooowwwwwww\?\! meow\. me\.\. oo\.\.w \~\'\)
regex.r: 此规则允许 $1 仅使用聊天消息和私语中的特定声音模式进行通信. 但这些模式不能在同一条消息中混合. 每条消息只能包含列表中的一个声音. 也就是说, 只有一个声音是有效的. 换句话说, 只要字母是按顺序的, 列表中声音的任何变体都是允许的.  (例如: 如果设置的声音是 'Meow', 那么以下是有效的消息: 'Me..ow? meeeow! mmeooowwwwwww?! meow. me.. oo..w ~')

regex.p: This rule alters (.+)\'s outgoing whisper messages while gagged to be garbled the same way normal chat messages are. This means\, that strength of the effect depends on the type of gag and \(OOC text\) is not affected\. Note\: While the rule is in effect\, the BC immersion preference \'Prevent OOC \& whispers while gagged\' is altered\, to allow gagged whispers\, since those are now garbled by the rule\. OOC prevention is not changed\.
regex.r: 此规则更改 $1 在被口球时发出的私语消息, 使其与正常聊天消息一样被压制. 这意味着效果的强度取决于口球的类型, 而(OOC 文本)不受影响. 注意: 在规则生效期间, BC 沉浸偏好 'Prevent OOC & whispers while gagged' 会发生变化, 以允许被压制的私语, 这些现在由规则压制. OOC 防护没有改变.

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to use OOC \(messages between round brackets\) in chat or OOC whisper messages at any moment\. This is a very extreme rule and should be used with great caution\!
regex.r: 此规则禁 $1 在任何时候在聊天中使用 OOC(圆括号之间的消息). 这是一个非常极端的规则, 应谨慎使用!

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to use certain words in the chat\. The list of banned words can be configured\. Checks are not case sensitive \(forbidding \'no\' also forbids \'NO\' and \'No\'\)\. Doesn\'t affect emotes and OOC text\, but does affect whispers\.
regex.r: 这个规则禁止 $1 在聊天中使用特定的单词.禁用的单词列表可以进行配置.检查时不区分大小写(禁用 'no' 也会禁用 'NO' 和 'No').这个规则不影响表情和 OOC 文本,但会影响私语.

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to send a message to all people inside a chat room\. Does not affect whispers or emotes\, but does affect OOC\.
regex.r: 在聊天室里,你不能给所有人发消息,但可以私聊或用表情符号.这个规则也会影响到OOC.

regex.p: (.+) can only say the custom name
regex.r: $1 只能说出定制名称

regex.p: This rule can set the time (.+) needs to leave the current room\, when items or a rule force her to leave it slowly\. The time can be set between 1 and 600 seconds \(10 mins\)\.
regex.r: 这个规则可以设定一个时间,当物品或规则逼迫她慢慢离开当前房间时,需要等待的时间.设置的时间范围是1到600秒(10分钟)之间.

regex.p: This rule forces (.+) to switch rooms from anywhere in the club to the chat room of the summoner after 15 seconds\. It works by sending a beep message with the set text or simply the word \'summon\' to (.+)\. Members who are allowed to summon (.+) can be set\. NOTES\: (.+) can always be summoned no matter if she has a leash or is prevented from leaving the room \(ignoring restraints or locked rooms\)\. However\, if the target room is full or locked\, she will end up in the lobby\. Summoning will not work if the room name is not included with the beep message\!
regex.r: 这个规则要求在15秒内,$1必须从俱乐部的任何地方切换到召唤者的聊天室.它通过向$2发送一条带有设置文本或简单包含单词'召唤'的蜂鸣消息来实现.允许设置可以召唤$3的成员.注意: 无论$4是否被束缚或禁止离开房间(忽略限制或锁定的房间),她总是可以被召唤.但是,如果目标房间已满或已锁定,她将会进入大堂.如果蜂鸣消息中没有包含房间名,那么召唤将无效！

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to enter all rooms, that are not on an editable whitelist of still allowed ones\. NOTE\: As safety measure this rule is not in effect while the list is empty\. TIP\: This rule can be combined with the rule \"Forbid creating new rooms\"\.
regex.r: 这个规则禁止 $1 进入不在可编辑白名单上的所有房间.注意: 作为安全措施,这个规则在列表为空时不会生效.提示: 这个规则可以和 '禁止创建新房间' 的规则一起使用.

regex.p: Here you switch the rule on\/off\, set a timer for activating\/deactivating \/ deleting the rule and define when it can trigger, such as either always or based on where the player is and with whom\.The small green\/red bars next to the checkboxes indicate whether a condition is true at present or not and the big bar whether this means that the rule is in effect\, if active\. Depending on the rule\, you can either enforce its effect\, log all violations\, or both at the same time\. Lastly on the bottom right\, you can set whether the trigger conditions of this rule should follow the global rules config or not\.
regex.r: 在这里,您可以切换规则的开关状态,设置激活、停用或删除规则的计时器,并定义它何时触发,比如说总是或者根据玩家的位置和与谁在一起.复选框旁边的小绿条和红条显示条件当前是否成立,大条则表示这个规则是否生效(如果已激活).具体来说,根据不同的规则,您可以选择强制执行效果、记录所有违规行为,或者两者都做.最后,在右下角,您可以设置这个规则的触发条件是否要遵循全局规则配置.

regex.p: This rule forces (.+) to talk as if they were gagged\, automatically garbling all of their speech\. This rule does not affect OOC\. This rule only affects whispers if the rule \"Garble whispers while gagged\" is also in effect\.
regex.r: 这个规则强迫 $1 像被堵嘴一样说话,自动让她的所有话都变得模糊.这个规则不影响 OOC.只有在 '口球时扭曲私语' 这个规则生效的时候,这个规则才会影响私语..

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to use OOC \(messages between round brackets\) in chat or OOC whisper messages while she is gagged\.
regex.r: 此规则禁止 $1 在被堵嘴时在聊天或 OOC 私聊消息中使用 OOC（圆括号内的消息）。

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to use the action command\. Action is a BCX feature that enables to format a message to look like a BC chat action\. If (.+) should be forbidden to use the command to communicate, this rule should be used\.
regex.r: 此规则禁止 $1 使用动作命令。动作是 BCX 的一项功能，可以将消息格式化为类似 BC 聊天动作的样式。如果应禁止 $2 使用该命令进行交流，则应使用此规则。

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to send any beeps with message, except to the defined list of member numbers\. Sending beeps without a message is not affected\. Optionally, it can be set that (.+) is only forbidden to send beeps while she is unable to use her hands \(e\.g\. fixed to a cross\)\.
regex.r: 此规则禁止 $1 发送带有消息的哔哔声，除非发送给定义的成员编号列表。发送不带消息的哔哔声不受影响。可选地，可以设置为仅当 $2 无法使用双手（例如固定在十字架上）时禁止发送哔哔声。

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to whisper anything to most people inside a chat room, except to the defined roles\. Also affects whispered OOC messages\.
regex.r: 此规则禁止 $1 在聊天室内向大多数人私聊任何内容，除非是向定义的角色私聊。此规则也影响私聊的 OOC 消息。

regex.p: This rule prevents (.+) from receiving any beep \(regardless if the beep carries a message or not\), except for beeps from the defined list of member numbers\. If someone tries to send (.+) a beep message while this rule blocks them from doing so, they get an auto reply beep, if the rule has an auto reply set\. (.+) won't get any indication that she would have received a beep unless the rule is not enforced, in which case she will see both the beep and the auto reply\. Optionally, the rule can be set to only activate while (.+) is unable to use her hands \(e\.g\. fixed to a cross\)\.
regex.r: 此规则阻止 $1 接收任何哔哔声（无论是否带有消息），除非来自定义的成员编号列表。如果有人尝试向 $2 发送哔哔消息但被此规则阻止，且规则设置了自动回复，则他们会收到自动回复的哔哔声。$3 不会收到任何提示表明她本应收到哔哔声，除非规则未生效，此时她会同时看到哔哔声和自动回复。可选地，可以设置为仅当 $4 无法使用双手（例如固定在十字架上）时激活此规则。

regex.p: This rule prevents (.+) from receiving any whispers, except from the defined roles\. If someone tries to send (.+) a whisper message while this rule blocks them from doing so, they get an auto reply whisper, if the rule has an auto reply set \(text field is not empty\)\. (.+) won't get any indication that she would have received a whisper unless the rule is not enforced, in which case she will see both the whisper and the auto reply\. This rule can also be used \(by dommes\) to prevent getting unwanted whispers from strangers in public\.
regex.r: 此规则阻止 $1 接收任何私聊消息，除非来自定义的角色。如果有人尝试向 $2 发送私聊消息但被此规则阻止，且规则设置了自动回复（文本字段不为空），则他们会收到自动回复的私聊消息。$3 不会收到任何提示表明她本应收到私聊消息，除非规则未生效，此时她会同时看到私聊消息和自动回复。此规则也可用于（由主导者）防止在公共场合收到陌生人的 unwanted 私聊消息。

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to use any \(sexual\) activities in chat rooms\. Other players can still use activities on her, as this rules does not block the arousal & sexual activities system itself, as forcing the according BC setting would\.
regex.r: 此规则禁止 $1 在聊天室中使用任何（性）活动。其他玩家仍然可以对她使用活动，因为此规则不会阻止 arousal 和性活动系统本身，这与强制更改相应的 BC 设置不同。

regex.p: This rule prevents (.+) from showing, removing or changing an emoticon \(afk, zZZ, etc\.\) over her head\. It also blocks her from using the emoticon command on herself\.
regex.r: 此规则阻止 $1 显示、移除或更改头顶的表情符号（如 afk、zZZ 等）。同时禁止她对自己使用表情符号命令。

regex.p: This rule gives (.+) a list of words from which at least one has to always be used in any chat message\. The list of mandatory words can be configured\. Checks are not case sensitive \(adding 'miss' also works for 'MISS' and 'Miss' - Note: 'Miiiiissss' would also match\)\. Doesn't affect whispers, emotes and OOC text\. There is a toggle for affecting whispers, too\.
regex.r: 此规则为 $1 提供一个单词列表，任何聊天消息中必须至少使用其中一个单词。必选单词列表可配置。检查不区分大小写（添加 'miss' 也会匹配 'MISS' 和 'Miss'——注意：'Miiiiissss' 也会匹配）。不影响私聊、表情和 OOC 文本。也可选择是否影响私聊。

regex.p: This rule forces (.+)'s base game setting 'Item permission' to configurable value and prevents her from changing it\.
regex.r: 此规则强制将 $1 的基础游戏设置 '物品权限' 设为可配置的值，并阻止她更改该设置。

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to do any room admin actions \(except for kick\/ban\), when she is restrained\. Note: This rule does not affect an admin's ability to bypass locked rooms, if restraints allow it\. Tip: This rule can be combined with the rule 'Force ´Return to chatrooms on relog´' to trap (.+) in it\.
regex.r: 此规则禁止 $1 在被束缚时执行任何房间管理操作（踢出/封禁除外）。注意：如果束缚允许，此规则不会影响管理员绕过锁定房间的能力。提示：此规则可与规则 '强制重新登录后返回聊天室' 结合使用，以将 $2 困在其中。

regex.p: This rule limits (.+)'s ability to send a message to all people inside a chat room to only the set number per minute\. Does not affect whispers or emotes, but does affect OOC\. Note: Setting '0' will have no effect, as there is another rule to forbid open talking completely\.
regex.r: 此规则限制 $1 在聊天室内向所有人发送消息的频率为每分钟仅可发送设定的次数。不影响私聊或表情，但会影响 OOC。注意：设置为 '0' 将无效，因为另有规则完全禁止公开发言。

regex.p: This rule forbids (.+) to send an emote \(with \* or \/me\) to all people inside a chat room to only the set number per minute\. Note: Setting '0' will have no effect, as there is another rule to forbid using emotes completely\.
regex.r: 此规则禁止 $1 在聊天室内向所有人发送表情（使用 * 或 /me）的频率为每分钟仅可发送设定的次数。注意：设置为 '0' 将无效，因为另有规则完全禁止使用表情。

regex.p: This rule gives (.+) a list of words from which at least one has to always be used in any emote message\. The list of mandatory words can be configured\. Checks are not case sensitive \(adding 'miss' also works for 'MISS' and 'Miss' - Note: 'Miiiiissss' would also match\)\.
regex.r: 此规则为 $1 提供一个单词列表，任何表情消息中必须至少使用其中一个单词。必选单词列表可配置。检查不区分大小写（添加 'miss' 也会匹配 'MISS' 和 'Miss'——注意：'Miiiiissss' 也会匹配）。

regex.p: This rule enforces full blindness when the eyes are closed\. \(Light sensory deprivation setting is still respected and doesn't blind fully\)
regex.r: 此规则在闭眼时强制完全失明。（轻度感官剥夺设置仍会生效，不会完全失明）

regex.p: This rule forces (.+)'s base game setting 'Arousal meter' to configurable value and prevents her from changing it\.
regex.r: 此规则强制将 $1 的基础游戏设置 '兴奋度计量条' 设为可配置的值，并阻止她更改该设置。

regex.p: This rule lets you define a minimum role which (.+) will automatically give room admin rights to \(if she has admin rights in the room\)\. Also has the option to remove admin rights from (.+) afterwards\.
regex.r: 此规则允许您定义一个最低角色，$1 会自动将房间管理员权限授予该角色（如果她在房间中拥有管理员权限）。还可选择在此后移除 $2 的管理员权限。

regex.p: This rule enforces full blindness when wearing any item that limits sight in any way\. \(This rules does NOT respect Light sensory deprivation setting and always forces player to be fully blind\. The crafting property 'thin' is not factored in either due to technical limitations\. \)
regex.r: 此规则在佩戴任何限制视力的物品时强制完全失明。（此规则不遵循轻度感官剥夺设置，并始终强制玩家完全失明。由于技术限制，制作属性 '薄' 也不会被考虑在内。）

regex.p: This rule forces (.+)'s base game setting 'Arousal speech stuttering' to configurable value and prevents her from changing it\.
